name: Bee Yard Wingman
notes: Signing in is easier.  If you leave Wingman to get the code from your email, it keeps your place when you come back so you can type the code.
If your email is on your club's member list, signing in takes you straight into the club.  If it isn't yet, Wingman says so and has a Check again button.
After you sign in, Club shows your club right away, without restarting the app.
My club has an events calendar.  Members can sign up for volunteer spots and get a reminder email.  A public link lets anyone see the events, or add them to a phone's calendar.
